title: slakpiinstance
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, msdyn_slaitemid, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, regarding_account, regarding_activitypointer, regarding_appointment, regarding_contact, regarding_email, regarding_fax, regarding_letter, regarding_phonecall, regarding_socialactivity, regarding_task, transactioncurrencyid.

elapsedtime.description: Paused duration of a KPI in business hours

failuretime.description: Enter the date and time when the service level agreement (SLA) key performance indicator (KPI) will expire.

msdyn_activeduration.description: Time taken in business hours by a KPI instance to reach the Success or failed state

name.description: Type a descriptive name for the service level agreement (SLA) key performance indicator (KPI) instance.

slakpiinstanceid.description: Unique identifier of the SLA KPI Instance.

status.description: Reason for the status of the service level agreement (SLA) key performance indicator (KPI) instance.

succeededon.description: Shows the date and time when the service level agreement (SLA) key performance indicator (KPI) success criteria was met.

warningtime.description: Enter the date and time when the service level agreement (SLA) key performance indicator (KPI)will go to a warning state.

warningtimereached.description: Shows information about whether the case has reached its warning time.

_msdyn_slaitemid_value.description: Unique identifier for SLA KPI Instance associated with SLA Item.

_ownerid_value.description: Enter the user or team who is assigned to manage the record.

_regarding_value.description: Unique identifier of the record that this service level agreement (SLA) key performance indicator (KPI) instance is associated with.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Choose the local currency for the record to make sure budgets are reported in the correct currency.
